verses.text: Iyi ni imigani ya Salomo, mwene Dawidi, umwami wa Isirayeli.
Intumbero y’iyi migani ni ukwigisha abantu ubwenge no kubatoza indero, no kubafasha gutahura amajambo y’ubwenge.
Yigisha abantu kugira ubwenge bwo kuroranya ibintu mu buzima, bagakora ibigororotse, ibitunganye n’ibibereye.
Iyo migani yigisha ubwenge abazi bike, abakiri bato ikabaha ubumenyi bwo guserangura.
Umunyabwenge niyumve iyi migani, yongereze ubumenyi, uwufise ubuseranguzi aronke ukurongorwa,
kugira ngo atahure iyi myibutsa n’iyi migani, amajambo y’abanyabwenge n’amabanga yayo.
Ukwubaha Uhoraho ni kwo tanguriro ry’ubwenge, ariko ibipfu bikengera ubwenge n’ugutozwa indero.
Mwana wanje, wumvire ico so akubwira, kandi ntukanke ico nyoko akwigisha.
Bizokubera urugori rw’ubuntu ku mutwe, n’umugufu ushariza izosi.
Mwana wanje, abanyavyaha nibakwosha, ntukabumvire.
Nibakubwira bati: “Ingo tujane; tuje gusesa amaraso, dutege umutego abatagira icaha;
ingo tubamire ari bazima, nk’uko imva imira abantu, tubamire bose nk’abaja muri rwa rwobo rw’urupfu;
ni ho tuzoronka ivyiza vyinshi, amazu yacu tuyuzuze ivyo tunyaze;
ingo nawe uzoronka umugabane wawe, tuzogabura ivyo tuzoronka vyose.”
Mwana wanje, ntuze wifatanye na bo, ntuze utumbereze ibirenge vyawe mu nzira zabo;
kuko birukira gukora ivyaha, bakihutira gusesa amaraso.
Gutega umutego inyoni zikubona ni ukwiruhiriza ubusa.
Abo bantu bazohitanwa n’umutego bateze; bicwe n’ivyo bateze abandi.
Iryo ni ryo herezo ry’abirukira inyungu mbi, izo nyungu mbi ni zo zihitana ubuzima bwabo.
Bwenge asemerera ari mu nzira, akaduza ijwi mu bibanza abantu bakoraniramwo.
Asemerera ari mu mayirabiri yuzuye urwamo, akavugira amajambo yiwe ku marembo y’igisagara ati:
“Yemwe banyabwengebuke mwe; muzogeza ryari kudakunda ubwenge? Namwe bacokoranyi, muzogeza ryari kunezerererwa ubucokoranyi? Namwe bipfu, muzogeza ryari kwanka ubumenyi?
Nimuze mwumvirize ukwihaniza kwanje, ndababwire ikiri ku mutima wanje, maze ntume muba abanyabwenge.
Ariko narabahamagaye muranka, ndabatega ibiganza ariko ntihagira n’umwe avyitaho.
Mwirengagije impanuro zanje, ntimwemera ukugabisha kwanje.
Nanje nzobatwenga nimwagwa mu vyago; nzokwitwengera nimwashikirwa n’amakuba,
ubwoba nibwabazako nk’igihuhusi, amakuba akabagwako kurya kw’agashururu, imibabaro n’agahinda bikabahwikira.
Maze abo bazompamagara ariko sinzobitaba; bazondonderana umwete ariko ntibazombona,
kuko banse ubumenyi, ntibahitamwo kwubaha Uhoraho .
Ko banse impanuro zanje, bakagaya ukugabisha kwanje,
bazorya ivyamwa vy’ingeso zabo, bahazwe n’ivyamwa vy’inama zabo.
Kuko ubunebwe bw’abanebwe ni bwo bubica, kandi ukuba sindabibazwa kw’ibipfu ni kwo kubirandura.
Ariko abanyumvira bose bazobaho amahoro, bagubwe neza, ata cago batinya.”
Mwana wanje, niwakira amajambo yanje, ukazigama ivyo ndakwihanikiriza,
ugatega ugutwi amajambo y’ubwenge, ugashira umutima wawe ku gutahura,
ugahamagara ubwenge, ukaririra ugutahura,
ukabirondera nk’uwurondera ifeza canke ubutunzi buhishijwe,
ico gihe uzomenya kwubaha Uhoraho ico ari co, kandi uzogira ugutahura kuvuye ku Mana.
Kuko Uhoraho ni we atanga ubwenge, kandi mu kanwa kiwe ni ho hava ubumenyi n’ugutahura.
Ni we afise intsinzi y’abagororotsi mu bubiko bwiwe, kandi ni we nkinzo y’abagenda batunganye.
Ni we azigama inzira z’abagororotsi, agakingira abamwizigiye.
Aho ni ho uzomenya ibigororotse, ibitunganye hamwe n’ibibereye, umenye n’inzira zibereye,
kuko ubwenge buzokwinjira mu mutima wawe, maze ubumenyi bube umunezero w’umushaha wawe.
Guhitamwo neza kuzoba umurinzi wawe, kandi ugutahura kuzokuzigama.
Ubwenge buzokurinda kugendera mu nzira z’ababi, bukurinde n’abavuga amajambo y’ubupfu.
Abo bata inzira zigororotse, bakagendera mu nzira z’umwijima.
Bahimbarwa no gukora ikibi, bagahimbarirwa ubuhumane bwabo.
Iminyuro yabo iragoramanze, kandi inzira bajana zirabazimiza.
Ubwenge buzokurinda umugore w’umusambanyikazi, bukurinde n’amajambo asosa y’umugore w’umunyangesombi,
yataye umugabo wo mu buto bwiwe akava mw’isezerano yagize imbere y’Imana.
Kwinjira inzu yiwe bijana mu rupfu, ni inzira ijana i kuzimu mu mva.
Nta wuja iwe ngo agaruke, canke ngo yongere asubire mu nzira y’ubuzima.
Ahubwo ugendere mu nzira y’abantu b’intungane, ugume mu nzira y’abagororotsi.
Kuko abagororotsi ni bo bazoba mu gihugu kandi inyankamugayo ni zo zizokigumamwo.
Ariko abanyakibi bazogikurwamwo, abahemu na bo bakirandurwemwo.
Mwana wanje, ntuze wibagire ivyo nakwigishije, ahubwo uzigame amabwirizwa yanje mu mutima wawe.
Ivyo niwabikora, bizokwongera imyaka yo kubaho, kandi ubuzima bwawe buzororanirwa.
Urukundo n’ubwizigirwa bize vyamane nawe, uze uvyambare mw’izosi, uvyandike mu mutima wawe.
Ni ho uzogira ikiganza ciza n’izina ryiza imbere y’Imana n’abantu.
Wizigire Uhoraho n’umutima wawe wose, ntiwishimire ugutahura kwawe.
Wame urondera ugushaka kwiwe mu vyo ukora vyose, na we azogorora inzira zawe.
Ntiwishimire ubwenge bwawe, ahubwo wubahe Uhoraho kandi uve mu kibi.
Ivyo bizotuma umubiri wawe ugira amagara meza, bitume n’amagufa yawe yoroherwa.
Wubahishe Uhoraho ubutunzi bwawe, hamwe n’ivya mbere vyo mu vyeze mu mirima yawe.
Na we azosesekaza umwimbu mu bigega vyawe, amato yawe yame asesekaye umuvinyu.
Mwana wanje, ntukagaye uguhana kw’ Uhoraho , kandi ntukanke ukugabisha kwiwe;
kuko Uhoraho agabisha abo akunda, kurya umuvyeyi abikorera umwana akunda.
Hahiriwe umuntu yironkeye ubwenge, akironkera ugutahura.
Kuko ubwenge busumvya agaciro ifeza, kandi ivyamwa vyabwo birusha agaciro inzahabu.
Ubwenge burusha agaciro akabuye kitwa imaragarita, kandi nta co kwipfuzwa na kimwe cogereranywa na bwo.
Kuramba kuri mu kuboko kwabwo kw’i buryo, mu kubamfu kwabwo na ho hari ubutunzi n’icubahiro.
Inzira zabwo ni inzira zinezereye, kandi ni iz’amahoro.
Ubwenge ni igiti c’ubugingo ku babugumbira, kandi ni umugisha ku babwumirako bose.
Ubwenge ni bwo Uhoraho yashingishije imfatiro z’isi, kandi ugutahura ni kwo yashirishijeho amajuru.
Kubera ubumenyi bwiwe, amasoko y’i kuzimu yaratobotse, ibicu na vyo bitonyanga imvura.
Mwana wanje, ntukareke ubwenge nyabwo n’ukurobanura, ngo bive imbere y’amaso yawe;
kuko ni vyo bizokubera ubuzima, bikubere ikirezi co gushariza mw’izosi.
Bizokuzigama mu nzira zawe, kandi ibirenge vyawe ntibizotsitara.
Niwaryama ntuzogira ico utinya; kandi niwasinzira, uzogira itiro riryoshe.
Ntugatinye ivyago bishitse giturumbuka, canke ukurandurwa gushikiye abanyakibi;
kuko Uhoraho ari we azokurinda, kandi azorinda ibirenge vyawe ngo ntibigwe mu mutego.
Mwana wanje, ntukareke kugirira neza ababikwiye mu gihe ufise ububasha bwo kubikora.
Ntukabwire umubanyi wawe uti: “Genda uzogaruka; nzoguha ejo,” kandi ufise ico womuha ubwo nyene.
Ntugategure kugirira nabi umubanyi wawe, uwo musanzwe mubanye mwumvikana.
Ntugatongane n’umuntu ata mpamvu, ata kibi yagukoreye.
Ntukipfuze kumera nk’abantu b’ibirandamuke, canke ngo wigane ingeso zabo na zimwe;
kuko abanyakibi ari ikizira k’ Uhoraho , ariko abamwubaha abagira abakunzi biwe.
Umuvumo w’ Uhoraho uri ku nzu y’umunyakibi, ariko ahezagira urugo rw’umugororotsi.
Uhoraho agaya abacokoranyi, ariko agirira ubuntu abaciye bugufi.
Umunyabwenge azoragwa icubahiro, ariko ibipfu bizokorwa n’isoni.

headings.text: Ubwenge ni bwo butanga ukubaho neza

verses.text: Bana banje, nimutege amatwi inyigisho z’umuvyeyi; muzishireko umutima kugira ngo mugire ubwenge.
Ndiko ndabaha inyigisho nyazo; none rero ntimukanke inyigisho zanje.
Kuko nanje narabaye umwana kuri data, kandi narakundwa cane na mama nk’umwana w’ikinege.
Data yanyigishije ati: “Ushire amajambo yanje ku mutima, ugendere mu mabwirizwa yanje, ni ho uzobona kubaho.
Rondera ubwenge, rondera ugutahura; ntiwibagire amajambo yanje canke ngo uyavemwo.
Ntugahebe ubwenge kuko ni bwo buzokuzigama; ahubwo ubukunde kuko ni bwo buzokurinda.
Kugira ngo ube umunyabwenge, rondera ubwenge. Naho vyogusaba gutanga ivyawe vyose, bitange uronke ugutahura.
Niwabuha agaciro, na bwo buzokugira uwuhambaye. Bugumbire, na bwo buzoguhesha icubahiro.
Buzokwambika urugori rusharije ku mutwe, bukwerekane wambaye urugori rw’ubwiza.”
Ntega amatwi mwana wanje, wemere ivyo nkubwira, ni ho imyaka yo kubaho kwawe izokwongerekana.
Ndakwigisha inzira z’ubwenge, kandi ndakurongorera mu nzira zigororotse.
Mu gutambuka ntakizogutangira, kandi niwiruka ntuzotsitara.
Ucakire inyigisho zanje, ntuziveko. Uzizigame neza kuko ni zo buzima bwawe.
Ntuze utumbereze ibirenge vyawe mu nzira z’abanyakibi, canke ngo ugendere mu ngeso z’inkozi z’ikibi.
Irinde inzira yabo, ntuyicemwo, ahubwo hindukira ufate inzira yawe.
Kuko ntibashobora gusinzira badakoze ikibi; ntibaruhuka batagize uwo batsitaza.
Barya ivyokurya bivuye mu kibi, bakanywa umuvinyu w’umuryano.
Inzira y’abagororotsi ni nk’umuco wo mu mutwenzi, ugenda urushiriza gukayangana gushitsa ku murango.
Ariko inzira y’abanyakibi imeze nk’umwijima w’umuzitanya, ntibamenya n’ico batsitarako.
Mwana wanje, niwumve ivyo nkubwira, utege amatwi amajambo yanje.
Ntuze wigere uyibagira, uyazigame mu mutima,
kuko azanira ubuzima abayakira, akabaha amagara meza mu mubiri wabo wose.
Urinde umutima wawe kuruta ibindi vyose, kuko muri wo ari ho hari isoko y’ubugingo.
Ushire kure yawe amajambo y’ubupfu, urinde akanwa kawe kuvuga amajambo mabi.
Wame uraba imbere yawe, amaso yawe uyahange ibiri imbere yawe.
Wiyumvire cane ku nzira ugiye gucamwo, utumbereze ibirenge vyawe mu nzira y’ukuri.
Ntukebereze i buryo canke i bubamfu, urinde ibirenge vyawe vyoye gukurikira ikibi.
Mwana wanje, shira umutima ku majambo y’ubwenge nkwigisha, wumvirize neza amajambo yanje akwigisha ugutahura,
kugira ngo ushobore kumenya ikibereye, akanwa kawe kavuge ivy’ubwenge.
Kuko akanwa k’umugore w’umusambanyikazi gasosa nk’ubuki, amajambo yiwe anyerera gusumvya amavuta.
Ariko mu nyuma arura gusumvya ikintu cose kirura, agacumita kurusha inkota y’ubugi bubiri.
Ibirenge vyiwe bimanuka bija mu rupfu, kandi intambuko ziwe nta handi zijana atari mu mva.
Ntiyiyumvira ku nzira ijana mu buzima, inzira ziwe ziramuzimiza, ariko ntabibona.
None rero, mwana wanje, ntega amatwi; ntiwirengagize ivyo ndakubwira.
Uze wigire kure uwo mugore, ntuze wegere n’umuryango w’inzu yiwe,
kugira ngo ntiwiyake icubahiro cawe ngo ugihe abandi, imyaka y’ubuzima bwawe ukayiha ruburakigongwe.
Abantu utazi ntibabe ari bo barya ubutunzi bwawe, ngo ivyo wabiriye akuya bitungishe inzu y’uwundi muntu.
Mu misi yawe ya nyuma uzoboroga, umubiri wawe umaze kuba akaheze.
Uzovuga uti: “Ese ingene nanse gutozwa indero! Ese ukuntu nirengagije ukugabishwa!
Vyangendeye gute ngo sinumvire abigisha banje, canke ngo ntege amatwi abarezi banje?
Ehe ngeze aho umwansi ashaka bidatevye, maramariye imbere y’ikoraniro ry’abantu.”
Unywe amazi yo mw’iriba ryawe wiharije, amazi atemba ava mw’iriba ryawe.
Mbega amasoko yawe akwiye gutemba akuzura amabarabara, canke imigende yawe igatembera mu bibanza vy’amahuriro?
Nibibe ivyawe bwite, ntukabisangire n’abahita.
Isoko ryawe riragahezagirwa, nawe unezerererwe umugore wo mu buto bwawe.
Ameze nk’impongokazi iteye igomwe, nk’ingeregere ihimbaye. Amabere yiwe akubumbe ibihe vyose, kandi wame ukwegwa n’urukundo rwiwe ibihe vyose.
Mwana wanje, ni igiki cotuma ukwegwa n’umusambanyikazi, ukagumbira igikiriza c’umugore w’icigenze?
Kuko ingeso z’umuntu zigaragarira Uhoraho , ni we asuzuma inzira ziwe zose.
Ibikorwa bibi vy’umunyakibi ni vyo bimubera umutego, kandi imigozi y’ivyaha vyiwe ni yo imuboha.
Azokwicwa no kutamenya ingene yitwara, azimizwe n’ubujuju bwiwe bwinshi.
Mwana wanje, nimba waremeye kurihira ideni mugenzawe, canke ugafata ingingo yo kwishingira umunyagahinga,
umaze gafatwa n’indahiro warahiye, waguye mu mutego w’amajambo yavuye mu kanwa kawe;
uzobigenze uku kugira ngo wibohore, kuko uzoba wamaze gukorokera mu maboko ya mugenzawe. Uze ugende wicishe bugufi imbere yiwe, umwinginge ushimitse.
Ntuze ukundire amaso yawe gusinzira, canke ibigohe vyawe ngo bitwarwe n’itiro.
Uze wikize nk’ingeregere ivuye mu maboko y’umuhigi, canke nk’inyoni ivuye mu mutego.
Niwigire ku kimonyo, yewe wa munebwe we! Raba ingene gikora hanyuma uce ubwenge.
Ntikigira uwugitegeka, uwukiganza, canke uwugikoresha.
Ariko cegeranya ivyokurya mu ci, kigatororokanya imfungurwa mw’iyimbura.
Mbega uzogeza ryari kuryama, yewe wa munebwe we? Uzova mw’itiro ryawe ryari?
Uravuga uti: “Hinge nisinzirire gatoya, mpungure gakeya, nigorore gatoya, mpfunye amaboko.”
Uko ni ko ubukene buzoguhwikira nk’igisuma, ubworo bugutere nk’umwambuzi.
Umuntu w’imburakimazi kandi w’umunyakibi, ni we yama abesha.
Abesha ku rwenge mu kuvuna ingohe, agakeburanisha ibirenge vyiwe, agakoresha ibimenyetso n’intoke ziwe.
Umutima wiwe wama utegura gukora ibibi, kandi ibihe vyose avyura imitongano.
Ni co gituma ivyago bizomugwako mu kanya gato, akarandurwa giturumbuka ubutakivyuka.
Hari ibintu bitandatu Uhoraho yanka, ahubwo ni indwi bimusesema:
amaso arabana abandi ubwibone, ururimi ruvuga ibinyoma, amaboko asesa amaraso y’uwutaco azira,
umutima utegura imigambi mibi, ibirenge vyirukira gukora ikibi,
icabona kivuga ibinyoma, hamwe n’umuntu ateranya abavukana.
Mwana wanje, wumve ivyo so agutegeka, kandi ntiwanke ivyo nyoko akwigisha.
Ubizigame mu mutima wawe ibihe vyose, uvyambare mw’izosi.
Uri ku rugendo, bizokurongora, uryamye bizokurarira; kandi niwavyuka bizokuganiriza.
Kuko ibwirizwa ni itara, inyigisho ni urumuri, ukugabisha no gutoza indero na vyo ni inzira ijana mu buzima.
Bizokurinda umugore w’ingeso mbi, n’akarimi gasosa k’umugore w’icigenze.
Ntukamwipfuze mu mutima wawe kubera ubwiza bwiwe, kandi ntiwemere ko agukwegakwegesha amaso yiwe.
Kuko maraya azogukwegera mu bukene, ariko umugore w’uwundi we kugukwegera urupfu.
Mbega umuntu yonyegeza umuriro mu mpuzu, impuzu ziwe ntizishe?
Umuntu yohonyora ku makara yaka, hanyuma ntashe?
Ni ko bimeze no ku wuryamana n’umugore w’uwundi muntu; nta wumukorako ngo abure guhanwa.
Abantu ntibagaya uwivye iyo ashaka kwivuna inzara.
Ariko iyo afashwe, ariha ivyo yivye bigwijwe incuro indwi, naho vyosaba kugurisha ubutunzi bw’umuryango wiwe bwose.
Ariko uwusambana n’umugore w’uwundi we ni igipfu; uwubikoze wese aba ashaka kuranduka.
Inguma n’ibimaramare ni vyo mugabane wiwe, kandi umugayo ntuzokwigera umuvako.
Ugupfuha gutuma umugabo w’uwo mugore agira ishavu ry’inkazi, kandi ntazogira ikigongwe nihagera ko yihora.
Ntazokwakira indishi y’akababaro n’imwe, ntazokwemera ingabire zawe naho womuha ibingana iki.
Mwana wanje, uzigame amajambo yanje, ubike amabwirizwa yanje muri wewe.
Uzigame amabwirizwa yanje kugira ngo ubone kubaho; urinde inyigisho zanje nk’uko urinda imbone y’ijisho ryawe.
Uzambare nk’impeta uzandike ku mutima wawe.
Bwira ubwenge uti: “Uri mushikanje,” ugutahura ukwite incuti yawe.
Bizokurinda umugore w’umunyangesombi, bikurinde umugore w’icigenze n’amajambo yiwe asosa.
Umusi umwe nari kw’idirisha ry’inzu yanje, maze ncishije mu gitambara gikinze,
ndaba muvbantu ata co binona. Muri bo mbonamwo umusore umwe, umusore w’umuyabaga atagira ubwenge,
ajabuka ibarabara hafi y’aho umwe muri abo bagore yaba, agenda atumbereye inzu yiwe.
Bwari buhwibiriye, buriko burira; ijoro n’umwijima bitanguye kuza.
Maze wa mugore, aza kumusanganira, yambaye nka maraya, yuzuye uburyarya mu mutima.
Yari umugore avugira hejuru kandi w’intumva ibirenge vyiwe ntivyaragama mu nzu yiwe.
Hamwe yaba ari mw’ibarabara; ahandi mu masoko, aronderera impande zose.
Nuko afata wa musore, aramusomagura, amubwira ata dusoni ati:
“Uno musi nashikanye ikimazi c’ishimwe; nashikije ico nasezeranye.
Ni co gituma naje kugusanganira; nashaka kukubona, none ehe turahuye.
Uburiri bwanje bushasheko uburengeti bwiza, n’amashuka meza yera derere ava muri Egiputa.
Uburiri bwanje nabusize ibimota neza bitamirana, ari vyo imibavu, alowe na kinamoni.
Kaze twinywere ku rukundo gushika buce; ingo twinezereze mu rukundo,
kuko umugabo wanje si ho ari, yafashe urugendo rwa kure.
Yatwaye amahera menshi, ntazogaruka ukwezi kudaheze.”
Nuko amuhendahendesha amajambo asosa, amukwegesha akarimi kiwe karesha.
Ubwo nyene aca aramukurikira nk’impfizi igiye mw’ibagiro, nk’igipfu baboshe bagira bagihane,
gushika umwampi umutobekeranije igitigu, nk’inyoni yiroha mu mutego itazi ko iza kuhasiga ubuzima.
None rero, bana banje, nimunyumvirize; mutege amatwi amajambo yanje.
Ntimukareke imitima yanyu ngo ihindukirire inzira ziwe, canke ngo izimirire mu nzira acamwo.
Kuko yagwishije benshi, kandi abo yishe ntibaharurika.
Inzu yiwe ni inzira ijana mu mva, imanuka ija mu kibanza c’abapfuye.
Ntiwumva ko Bwenge ariko ahamagara n’ijwi rirenga? Ntiwumva ko ugutahura kudugije ijwi ryakwo?
Ahagaze ku gatwe k’umusozi, no ku mahwane y’inzira.
Arasemerera ari ku marembo aja mu gisagara no ku mabarabara ajayo.
Avuga ati: “Yemwe bagabo, ni mwebwe mbwira; ndugije ijwi mpamagara abantu bose.
Yemwe mwa mburabwenge, nimuronke ubwenge. Namwe mwa bijuju, nimuronke ugutahura.
Nimunyumvirize, kuko mfise ivyiza vyo kubabwira, nteranuye akanwa kanje ngo mbabwire ibibereye.
Akanwa kanje kavuga ukuri, kuko iminwa yanje yanka ububeshi bw’uburyo bwose.
Amajambo yo mu kanwa kanje yose aragororotse, nta na rimwe muri yo rigoramye canke ry’uruhendo,
yose arumvikana ku bafise ubwenge, kandi aragororotse ku baronse ubumenyi.
Nimuhitemwo inyigisho zanje muzirutishe ifeza, n’ubumenyi muburutishe inzahabu.
Kuko ubwenge buhambaye kurusha amabuye y’agaciro, kandi nta co kwipfuzwa cogereranywa na bwo.
Jewe Bwenge mbana no kwiyubara. Kandi mfise ubwenge no kurobanura.
Kwubaha Uhoraho bitera kwanka ikibi. Ni co gituma nanka ubwibone, ukwishira hejuru, ingeso mbi hamwe n’amajambo y’uruhendo.
Kuja inama no kugira ivyiyumviro birashe ni ivyanje; mfise ugutahura hamwe n’ububasha.
Abami ni jewe ndabaha kuganza, abatware nkabaha gushinga amategeko abereye.
Abaganwa baganza kubera jewe, co kimwe n’abashizwe hejuru hamwe n’abacamanza bo kw’isi bose.
Nkunda abankunda, kandi abandondera bose bazondonka.
Ubutunzi n’icubahiro biri kumwe nanje, hamwe n’amatungo n’ubugororotsi.

Ntukagiriranire ubugenzi n’umuntu yihuta kuraka, kandi ntukifatanye n’uwurakishwa n’ubusa,
ahandi ho wohava umera nka bo, ubuzima bwawe ukabuta mu mutego.
Ntukishinge uwundi mu myenda yiwe canke ngo wiyemeze ko uzomwishurira,
kuko nutashobora kuriha n’uburiri uryamako bazobugukurako.
Ntuzokwunguruze akarimbi kashinzwe na ba sogokuruza.
Hari abantu b’abanyamwete mu vyo bakora urabona? Abo bazokorera imbere y’abami ntibazokorera abasanzwe.
Niwasangira n’umutware, uzoshire umutima ku bishizwe imbere yawe.
Niwaba wari usanzwe urya cane, ugerageze ugabanye.
Ntukipfuze ivyokurya vyiwe biryoshe, kuko ivyo vyokurya birahenda.
Ntukarushwe no kwiruka inyuma y’ubutunzi, ariko ugire ubwenge bwo kwihangana.
Ubutunzi uba ukibukubise ijisho bukaba bwagurutse, kuko bumera amababa bukaguruka nk’inkukuma.
Ntukarye ivyokurya vy’uwufise ijisho ribi, canke ngo wipfuze ivyokurya biryoshe vyiwe;
aguma aharura igiciro cavyo, aranakubwira ati: “Fungura, nunywe!” Ariko ntibiba bivuye ku mutima.
Utwo watamiye uzotudahwa, kandi amajambo yawe yo kumushimira azoba yapfuye ubusa.
Ntukaganirize igipfu, kuko kizogaya ubwenge buri mu majambo yawe.
Ntukunguruze akarimbi kandi ntukarenganye impfuvyi,
kuko Umucunguzi wabo ari uwuhambaye; ni we ubwiwe azobaburanira.
Ushire umutima wawe ku kwigishwa, wongere utege amatwi amajambo y’ubumenyi.
Ntubure guhana umwana wawe; niwamukubita inkoni ntazopfa.
Umuhanishe inkoni, uzoba umurinze ubupfu bw’umushaha.
Mwana wanje, niwagira ubwenge bwo mu mutima, umutima wanje uzohimbarwa.
Ibingize vyose bizonezerwa akanwa kawe nikavuga ibituganye.
Ntuze wemerere umutima wawe kwipfuza ivy’abanyavyaha, ariko wame uhahamiye kwubaha Uhoraho .
Ni ho uzogira ivyizigiro vya kazoza, kandi ivyo vyizigiro ntibitetereza.
Ntega amatwi Mwana wanje, kandi ugire ubwenge, uzigamire umutima wawe mu nzira igororotse.
Ntukifatanye n’imborerwa, canke ngo usangire n’abakunzi b’inda,
kuko bariko baja mu bukene, kandi itiro ryinshi rizobambika imishambara.
Umvira so wawe, we yakuvyaye, kandi ntugaye nyoko mu myaka yiwe y’ubusaza.
Wigurire ukuri, kandi ntuzokugurishe. Uronke ubwenge, indero nziza hamwe n’ugutahura.
Se w’intungane agira umunezero mwinshi, kandi uwufise umwana w’umunyabwenge aramuhimbarirwa.
None rero uzohimbare so na nyoko! Nyoko yakuvyaye umutere umunezero.
Mwana wanje, numpe umutima wawe, kandi amaso yawe uyagumize ku nzira zanje.
Kuko umusambanyikazi ni icobo kirekire, kandi umugore w’icigenze ni ikinogo caga.
Yibundira abantu nk’umwambuzi, agatuma abagabo b’ibihemu bagwira.
Ni nde abonye ibara? Ni nde afise umubabaro? Ni nde afise amahane? Ni nde afise imyidogo? Ni nde afise inguma zatari zikenewe? Ni nde afise ijisho ritukurije?
Ni abama mu bunywero, bama bahonja ku nzoga nshasha.
Ntukihweze inzoga itukurije, ibiragira mu kirahuri, ikimiminura!
Amaherezo yayo ikomorana nk’inzoka, ubumara bwayo ni nk’ubw’inkoma.
Amaso yawe azoraba ntabibone neza, n’ubwenge bwawe buziyumvira ibitaroranye.
Uzomera nk’uwuryamye hagati mu kiyaga, canke uwuryamye ku mutwe w’inyuma w’ubwato.
Uzovuga uti: “Bankubise ariko sinababaye. Bampotaguye ariko nta na kimwe numva. Mbega nza kuvyuka ryari ngo nsubire nsome rimwe?”
Ntukipfuze kuba nk’ababi, ntukipfuze kuba mu mugwi wabo,
kuko imitima yabo yiyumvira kugira nabi, kandi iminwa yabo ivuga ivyo gutera imivurungano.
Ubwenge ni bwo butuma inzu yubakwa, kandi ugutahura ni kwo kuyikomeza.
Ugutahura ni kwo gutuma ivyumba vyayo vyuzura ubutunzi bwiza bw’igiciro.
Umunyabwenge agira ubushobozi bwinshi, kandi uwutahura agwiza inkomezi.
None rero ntuzoje mu ntambara utabanje kugirwa inama z’ubwenge; kuko intsinzi iva ku bajenama benshi.
Ubwenge buri aho igipfu kidahamvya; iyo kiri mw’ikoraniro ku nama ntikironka ico kivuga.
Uwigira inama yo gukora ikibi yitwa umugizi wa nabi.
Imigambi y’ubupfu ni icaha, kandi umucokoranyi yankwa n’abantu.
Niwiyonjorora rukamvye, uzoba wari ufise inkomezi nke.
Urokore abatwawe kwicwa kubera akarenganyo, abajugumizwa n’uko bagira bicwe ntuzobirengagize.
Niwavuga uti: “Ariko ntitwabimenye,” mbega uwusesa imitima ntazoba abibona? Uwuzigama ubugingo bwawe arazi ko wari ubizi. Ni we azoha impera umuntu wese, ikwiranye n’ibikorwa yakoze.
Mwana wanje, uzoje urarya ubuki, kuko ni bwiza. Ubuki buvuye mu kimamara burasosa ku rurimi.
Ariko kandi umenye ko ubwenge na bwo busosera umushaha. Niwaburonka, uzogira ivyizigiro vya kazoza keza, kandi ivyo vyizigiro ntibizogutetereza.
Ntuzokwibunde inyuma y’inzu y’umugororotsi ugomba kumugirira nabi, kandi ntugasahure ivy’aho aba.
Kuko umugororotsi naho yogwa incuro indwi azosubira ahaguruke. Ariko abanyavyaha bazogwishwa n’amakuba.
Ntuze unezerwe umwansi wawe niyagwa, kandi niyatsitara umutima wawe ntuze unezerwe.
Kuko vyohava bibabaza Uhoraho , bigatuma amukurako uburake bwiwe.
Ntugashavurire inkozi y’ikibi, kandi ntugashake kuba nk’umubi.
Kuko inkozi z’ibibi ntizigira ivyizigiro vya kazoza, kandi itara ry’umubi rizozimwa.
Mwana wanje, wubahe Uhoraho , wongere wubahe umwami, kandi ntukifatanye n’abagarariji,
kuko abo bompi bazomuteza ivyago ningoga. Kandi mbega ni nde yoshobora kumenya ivyago bazomuteza ingene bingana?
Iyi ni iyindi migani y’abanyabwenge: Guhengama mu rubanza ni bibi:
Umucamanza abwira umubi ati: “Urera,” azovumwa n’abantu, kandi amahanga azomurakira.
Ariko uwuhana uwakoze icaha azoba agize neza, kandi imigisha myinshi izomuzako.
Inyishu igororotse imeze nk’ugusomana kw’abakundana.
Banza uringanize neza ivyo hanze, utegure imirima yawe, hanyuma ubone kwubaka inzu yawe.
Ntukaburanye umubanyi wawe ata mvo, kandi ntukamubeshere.
Kandi Ntukavuge uti: “Reka ndamwishure ivyo yankoreye, ndamusubirize mu nkoko ibihwanye n’ivyo yakoze.”
Umusi umwe naciye mu murima w’umunebwe, nca no mu ruzabibu rw’umuntu w’imburabwenge;
nsanga ahantu hose hameze amahwa, urwiri rwameze hose, inzitiro z’amabuye zarahenaguritse.
Maze niyumvira ku vyo mbonye, na vyo bimpa icigwa:
Niwavuga uti: “Hinge nisinzirire gatoya, mpungure gakeya, nigorore gatoya, mpfunye amaboko,”
ubukene buzoguhwikira nk’igisuma, ubworo bugutere nk’umwambuzi.
Iyi ni iyindi migani ya Salomo, yegeranijwe n’umujenama w’umwami Hezekiya, umwami w’i Buyuda:
Icubahiro c’Imana ni uguhisha ibintu, ariko icubahiro c’abami ni ukubihishura.
Nk’uko ijuru riri hejuru cane, n’i kuzimu hakaba harehare, ni ko umutima w’umwami ata wumenya ibiwurimwo.
Tyorora ifeza, izohinduka igikoresho c’umucuzi.
Kura umubi imbere y’umwami, inganji yiwe izokomezwa n’ubugororotsi.
Ntukishire hejuru imbere y’umwami, kandi ntugasabe icicaro mu bahambaye.
Ni vyiza kurindira bakakubwira bati: “Shika hano imbere” aho kwirukanwa kure umaramara imbere y’abubahwa. Ivyo ni vyo umaze kwibonera.
Ntukihute kwitwarira umubanyi mu bucamanza, kuko agutsinze womaramara, ukabura uko ubigenza.
Nihagira ico mupfa n’umubanyi wawe, ntuzobifatireko ngo umene ibanga uwundi muntu yakubwiye,
abandi bohava bavyumva bakakwagiriza urusaku, ukaba wambaye iceyi utazikurako.
Ijambo rivuzwe mu gihe caryo ni ryiza; rimeze nk’icamwa c’inzahabu mu nkoko y’ifeza.
Ku wufise ugutwi kwumva, impanuro y’umunyabwenge imeze nk’ihereni ry’inzahabu, canke urugori rw’inzahabu nziza.
Nk’uko amazi akanye amerera isi mu bushuhe bwo mu ci, ni ko intumwa y’umwizigirwa imerera uwayitumye. Isubiza itoto umutima wa shebuja.
Uwusezerana gutanga ingabire ariko ntashitse, ameze nk’ibicu n’umuyaga bitazana imvura.
Ukwihangana bigondoza umutware, kandi ururimi rwiyoroheje rushobora kuvuna igufa.
Niwaronka ubuki, uzorye ubugereranye, kuko niwarya bwinshi cane uzobudahwa.
Ntukamize ikirenge mu rugo rw’umubanyi, kugira ngo ntibazoguharuruke, bakakwanka.
Umuntu arementaniriza ibinyoma umubanyi wiwe ameze nk’ishoka, inkota canke umwampi usongoye.
Gushira ivyizigiro ku muhemu mu gihe c’ivyago, ni nko guhekenyesha iryinyo ricitse, canke kugendesha ukuguru kuvunitse.
Uwuririmbira uwufise umutima ubabaye ameze nk’uwiyambura impuzu mu gihe c’imbeho, canke uwusuka inkarisha mu gikomere.
Umwansi wawe niyasonza, uramugaburira; niyanyoterwa umuhe ico kunywa.
Uzoba umusutse amakara yaka ku mutwe, kandi Uhoraho azobiguhera impera.
Nk’uko umuyaga uturuka mu buraruko uzana imvura, ni ko ururimi ruvuga urusaku rutera kwiraburanirwa.
Wopfuma wibana mu mfuruka y’igisenge c’inzu, hako ubana mu nzu nziza n’umugore w’intonganya.
Nk’uko amazi apfutse amerera umuntu anyotewe, ni ko inkuru nziza ivuye kure imera.
Umugororotsi ahendwa n’umunyakibi akifatanya na we aba ameze nk’iriba ritobwe canke ryuzuyemwo isuri.
Si vyiza kurya ubuki bwinshi kandi si vyiza ko umunyacubahiro arondera ko bakimuha.
Umuntu adashobora kwirinda ishavu ameze nk’igisagara gifise inzitiro zasenyutse.
Nk’uko shelegi itabereye kugwa mu ci canke imvura mw’iyimbura, ni ko icubahiro kidakwiye igipfu.
Nk’uko intamba iguruka kandi nk’uko inyamanza iguruka, ni ko umuvumo uvumiwe ubusa umera.
Nk’uko ikimoko kibereye ifarasi, n’umujiginya ukabera indogoba, ni ko umugongo w’igipfu ubereye inkoni.
Ntugasubize igipfu ibihwanye n’ubupfu bwaco, ahandi ho uzoba ubaye nka co.
Ariko uze wishure igipfu ibigaragaza ubupfu bwaco, kugira ngo nticigire umunyabwenge.
Kurungikana ubutumwa igipfu ni nko kwica ukuguru canke kunywa uburozi.
Amajambo y’ubwenge mu kanwa k’igipfu, ni nk’ukuguru kuvunitse gusigaye kurereta ata co kumaze.
Guha icubahiro igipfu ni nko kubohera ibuye ku mugozi
Umugani uciwe n’igipfu umeze nk’ihwa rihanda mu kigaza c’imborerwa.
Uwuha akazi igipfu canke uwuhita wese ameze nk’uwupfa kurasa mu bantu.
Nk’uko imbwa isubira ku vyo yadashwe, ni ko igipfu gisubiramwo ubupfu bwaco.
Igipfu gifise amahirwe kurusha uwibaza ko ari umunyabwenge kandi atari we.
Umunyabute avuga ati: “Hari intare mu nzira, intare y’inkazi iriko iratontoma mu nzira!”
Nk’uko urugi rwizungurutsa ku mapata yarwo ni ko umunebwe yihindukiza ku buriri bwiwe.
Umunebwe atwara ukuboko mw’isahani, ariko akananirwa no kukugarukana ku munwa.
Umunyabute yibwira ko ari umunyabwenge kurusha abantu indwi bashobora kwishurana ubwenge.
Umuntu ari ku nzira arengana akisuka mu bihari bitamwerekeye ameze nk’umuntu afashe imbwa amatwi.
Umuntu abesha mugenziwe, agaca yivugira ati: “Nariko ndatebura,”
ameze nk’uwurasa ibishirira canke imyampi yica mu bantu.
Nk’uko iyo inkwi ziheze, umuriro uzima, ni ko n’iyo ata rusaku ruhari ibihari bihera.
Nk’uko urubeya rufatisha amakara canke inkwi, ni ko uwukunda gutongana atangura ibihari.
Amajambo y’urusaku ameze nk’ivyokurya biryoshe; aramanuka agashika i bwina mu mutima w’umuntu.
Amajambo meza ava mu mutima mubi ameze nk’umuringa w’ifeza ushizwe ku nkono y’ibumba.
Umwankanyi yihisha inyuma y’amajambo yiwe aryoshe, ariko umutima wiwe urimwo inama z’ubuhemu.
Naho amajambo yiwe aryohera amatwi, ntukamwizere; umutima wiwe wuzuye ubuyobe.
Naho yogenda arabesha ahisha uburyarya bwiwe, ibikorwa bibi vyiwe bizoja ku mugaragaro.
Uwimbira ikinogo uwundi ni we azokigwamwo; kandi uwuzotembagariza ikibuye ku wundi, ni we kizofyonyora.
Ururimi rubesha rwanka abo rubabaza, kandi akanwa kavuga ibinyomya karasenyura.
Ntukishimire ivy’ejo, kuko nta wumenya ivyo haramukana.
Uzoshimwe n’uwundi, atari akanwa kawe; azobe uwo hanze, atari iminwa yawe.
Ibuye riraremereye, kandi umusenyi ugira ibilo vyinshi, ariko ugusotora kw’igipfu kuremera gusumba ivyo vyompi.
Ishavu ni umwicanyi, kandi uburake butwara nk’umukuba w’uruzi; ariko ni nde yohagarara imbere y’ishari?
Gukeburirwa ahabona kuruta urukundo rwinyegeje.
Umukunzi agukomeretsa aba ari uwo kwizigira, ariko ukugumbirana kw’umwansi ni agahemo gasa.
Ku wuhimvye ubuki burabiha, ariko ku wushonje n’ibirura birasosa.
Uwangarira kure y’i muhira ameze nk’inyoni iyererera kure y’icari.
Ibimota neza binezera umutima, nayo ibinezero vy’umugenzi bikava ku mutima umuhanura neza.
Ntugahebe umugenzi wawe canke umugenzi w’umuryago wawe, kandi ntukaje ku ncuti yawe ku musi ivyago biguteye, kuko umubanyi wa hafi asumba incuti ya kure.
Gira ubwenge, mwana wanje, maze uhimbare umutima wanje; ni ho nzoronka ico nishura abantuka.
Umunyamakenga yama abona icago kitaramushikira akacikinga, ariko igipfu gipfa kugenda, hanyuma kikisanga mu kaga.
Twara impuzu y’uwishinze uwo atazi, ufate ingwati y’uwishinze abahita.
Nihagira uwuzinduka guhezagira mugenziwe n’ijwi rirenga, ico kizomubera nk’umuvumo.
Ivano riguma ritonyanga ku musi imvura yirijeko ni nk’umugore atongana.
Kumutesha ni nko kugumya umuyaga, canke kugumya amavuta mu kiganza.
Nk’uko icuma gikarisha ikindi cuma; ni ko umuntu akarishanya na mugenziwe.
Uwututurira umusukoni azorya ivyamwa vyawo; kandi uwukingira shebuja azohabwa icubahiro.
Nk’uko umuntu abona ishusho yiwe mu mazi; ni ko ubuzima bw’umuntu bwerekana umutima wiwe.
Uko Rupfu na Muranduzi batigera bahaga; ni ko n’amaso y’abantu ameze.
Ifeza n’inzahabu bitunganywa n’umuriro, ariko umuntu asuzumwa n’ugushimagizwa.
Naho wosekura igipfu mw’isekuro, ukakinoza nk’uwusekuza ingano umuhini, ntiwogikuramwo ubupfu bwaco.
Gira umwete wo kumenya ibitungwa vyawe ingene vyifashe; umenye neza amasho yawe ingene ameze
kuko ubutunzi ntibwamaho, nk’uko urugori rutamaho uko urunganwe rugenda rukurikirana.
Ubwatsi bumaze gutemwa haza ubundi, ubwo ku misozi bukegeranywa,
imyagazi yawe izokwambika, kandi impene zawe zizokugurira itongo.
Uzokamira umuryango wawe amata y’impene akwiye, agutungire incoreke zawe.
Abanyakibi bahunga ata wubirukanye, ariko umugororotsi arinda nk’intare.
Iyo igihugu kigumutse kiganzwa na benshi, ariko umutware afise ubwenge abungabunga umutekano.
Umutware acinyiza aboro ameze nk’imvura y’isegenya idasiga igiterwa inyuma.
Abataye ivyagezwe bashira hejuru abanyakibi, ariko abavyubaha barabagwanya.
Inkozi z’ibibi ntizitahura ibibereye, ariko abarondera Uhoraho batahura vyose.
Umukene agendera mu bugororotsi aruta umutunzi w’indyarya.
Umunyabwenge wese yumvira ivyagezwe, ariko uwugendana n’abakunzi b’inda atetereza se.
Uwigwiriza ubutunzi mu kwaka inyungu y’umurengera ku vyo aguranye umukene, abwegeraniriza uwundi azofasha aboro.
Uwanka kwumva ivyagezwe, amasengesho yiwe aba igisesema.
Uwuzimiza umugororotsi agaca mu nzira mbi ni we agwa mu mutego, ariko inyankamugayo izoragwa ivyiza.
Umutunzi yigira umunyabwenge mu vyiyumviro vyiwe; ariko umukene w’umunyabwenge aramuhinyura.
Iyo abagororotsi banesheje haba umunezero mwinshi, ariko iyo umunyakibi ashizwe hejuru, abantu bose barinyegeza.
Uwuhisha ivyaha vyiwe nta mahirwe agira, ariko uwuvyatura akabiheba agirirwa ubuntu.
Hahiriwe umuntu yama ahindira agashitsi imbere y’ Uhoraho , ariko abakomantaza imitima bazogwa mu vyago.
Uko intare itontoma ihiga idubu ni ko umutware mubi amerera abakene.
Umutware atagira ugutahura aracinyiza, uwanka amaronko mabi azorambira ku ngoma.
Uwubujijwe amahororo n’amaraso yasheshe ahungira mu mva; ntimuze mumutangire.
Inyankamugayo izorokorwa mu vyago, ariko uwugoramika inzira ziwe azogwa mu rwobo.
Uwurima itongo ryiwe azoronka umwimbu mwinshi, ariko uwirukira ibitagira ikimazi azohaga ubukene.
Umwizigirwa azokwuzuzwa imigisha, ariko uwihutira kuronka ubutunzi ntazobura guhanwa.
Kurenganya si vyiza; ariko hariho abarya igiturire c’umukate.
Uwipfuza ivy’abandi yihutira gutunga, kandi ntamenya ko ubukene bumurindiriye.
Uwuhanura mugenziwe azobimushimira, gusumvya uwumushigikira mu gahemo.
Uwusahura se na nyina akibwira ati: “Nta co bitwaye,” ni umugenzi w’umuranduzi.
Uwipfuza ivy’abandi atera umuvurungano, ariko uwizigira Uhoraho aratera imbere.
Uwiyizigira ubwiwe ni igipfu, ariko uwugendana ubwenge asimba ivyago.
Uwugaburira aboro nta co azobura, ariko uwubiyobagiza azokwuzurako imivumo.
Iyo umunyakibi agiye ku butegetsi abantu barinyegeza, ariko iyo umunyakibi apfuye, abagororotsi baragwira.
Uwugamika izosi akanka guhanurwa, azovunagurwa vuba, ata gitabara.
Iyo abagororotsi bagiye ku butegetsi, abantu baranezerwa; ariko iyo umunyakibi atwaye, abantu baraboroga.
Uwukunda ubwenge azanira umunezero se, ariko uwugendana n’abasambanyi yisesagurirako itunga ryiwe.
Iyo umwami aca izibereye, aha impore igihugu, ariko uwukunda ibiturire aragitabagura.
Uwuhenda umubanyi wiwe aba ateze umutego ibirenge vyiwe.
Umunyakibi agwa mu mitego yiwe, ariko umugororotsi araririmba akanezerwa.
Umugororotsi yitwararika gucira abakene iziroranye, ariko umunyakibi nta bwenge bwo kubimenya agira.
Abacokoranyi bagumura igisagara, ariko abanyabwenge bakuraho uburake.
Iyo umunyabwenge ajanye ikijuju imbere y’intahe, gishobora kuraka canke kigatwenga, nta co abikuramwo.
Abasesa amaraso banka inyankamugayo, kandi bica abagororotsi.
Igipfu cirata uburake bwaco, ariko umunyabwenge arabuhwamika.
Iyo umutegetsi yumvirije ibinyoma, abatware biwe bose baba babi.
Umukene n’uwumucinyiza bafise ico bahurirako: Uhoraho ni we aha amaso yabo bompi kubona.
Umwami niyacira izibereye abakene, inganji yiwe izohoraho.
Inkoni yo guhana itanga ubwenge, ariko umwana atarezwe amaramaza nyina.
Iyo umunyakibi ateye imbere, n’icaha ni uko, ariko umugororotsi azokwihweza ukugwa kwiwe.
Toza indero umwana wawe, na we azoguha amahoro; azonezereza umutima wawe.
Iyo ata yerekwa rihari, abantu barazimira; ariko hahiriwe umuntu agendera mu vyagezwe.
Umukozi ntakosorwa n’amajambo gusa, n’iyo yumvise ico abwiwe ntagishirako umutima.
Hari ivyizigiro ku muntu w’igipfu, kurusha uwuvuga atiyumviriye.
Uwufyinisha umukozi wiwe akiri muto, amutera kugira iherezo ribi.
Uwihuta kuraka atera imivurungano, kandi uwukaza ishavu akora ivyaha vyinshi.
Ubwirasi bw’umuntu bumusubiza hasi, ariko uwicishije bugufi arubahwa.
Uwifatanya n’umusuma aba yiyanka, urahira ko uvuga ukuri, kandi utari bukuvuge.
Gutinya abantu bita mu mutego, ariko abizera Uhoraho barawusimba.
Abantu benshi barondera kwakirwa n’umutware, ariko gucirwa iziroranye bitangwa n’ Uhoraho .
Abagororotsi banka uburyarya, ariko abanyakibi banka abubaha Imana.
Aya ni amajambo ya Aguri mwene Yake, uwavugishijwe. Uwo yabariye Utiyeli, Itiyeli na Ukali, ati: “Ndatuntuye, ewe Mana, ndatuntuye kandi ndarushe, ewe Mana.
Ndi ikijuju kurusha abandi bose, singira ugutahura kw’abantu.
Sinigishijwe ubwenge, kandi sinzi Uwera.

Ni nde yagiye mw’ijuru hanyuma akagaruka? Ni nde yegeranirije umuyaga mu kiganza ciwe? Ni nde yegeranirije amazi mu mutamana wiwe? Ni nde yashizeho impera z’isi? Izina ryiwe ni nde, kandi imfura yiwe ni nde? Mbarira nimba ubizi!
Ijambo ry’Imana ryose ni iryo kwizerwa; ni inkinzo ku bayihungirako.
Ntihagire ico uzokwongera ku majambo yayo, ahandi ho izoguhana ikwereke ko uri umubeshi.
Hari ibintu bibiri ngusaba, ewe Mana; kandi ntubinyime nkiriho:
undinde ibinyoma n’ububeshi, bimbe kure; ntumpe ubukene canke ubutunzi bwinshi, ariko umpe ibinkwiye buri musi.
Nohava ntunga nkakugaya, nti Uhoraho ni iki? Canke nkaba umukene nkiba, nkatukisha izina ry’Imana yanje.
Ntukavuge nabi umukozi imbere ya shebuja, kuko azokuvuma, kandi uzohanirwa icaha cawe.
Hari abavuma ba se, kandi ntibahezagire ba nyina,
bakibwira ko ari beza, kandi batikuyeko imyanda ibariko;
bafise amaso y’ubwibone, barabira abandi hasi.
Hari abafise amenyo ameze nk’inkota, imibangabanga yabo irimwo imbugita. Batabagura aboro kw’isi, abakene bakabatabagurira mu bantu.
Umuyoka ufise abakobwa babiri. Barasemerera bati: ‘Zana! Zana!’ Hari ibintu bitatu bidahaga, n’ica kane kitigera kivuga kiti: ‘Geza aho’:
imva, inda y’ingumba, isi idahaga amazi, hamwe n’umuriro utigera uvuga uti: ‘Geza aho!’
Ijisho ry’uwugaya se, rigakengera nyina ashaje, rizonokorwa n’ibikona vyo mu biyaya, riribwe n’ibinyakabaka.
Hari ibintu bine bintangaza cane, mbere ni bine ntatahura:
inzira y’inkona mu kirere, inzira y’inzoka ku gitandara, inzira y’ubwato mu kiyaga, n’inzira y’umusore ku nkumi.
Uku ni ko umusambanyikazi abigenza: ararya hanyuma akihanagura, maze akavuga ati: ‘Nta kibi nigeze nkora.’
Hari ibintu bitatu bijugumiza isi, mbere ni bine idashobora kwihanganira:
umugurano abaye umwami, igipfu cujuje ivyokurya,
umugore atisonera mugabo akarongorwa, hamwe n’incoreke isubirira inabuja.
Hari ibintu bine bitobito kw’isi, ariko biciye ubwenge cane:
Ibimonyo ni udukoko dutoduto, ariko biriziganiriza ivyokurya vyo mu ci;
inkezi ni uturemwa tw’utunyantegenke, ariko twubaka inzu yatwo mu gitandara,
inzige ntizigira umwami, ariko zigira hamwe mu migwi;
umuserebanyi ushobora gufatishwa amaboko, ariko uwusanga mu birimba vy’abami.
Hari ibinyabuzima bitatu bitambuka neza, mbere ni bine bigenda birashonyanga:
intare, ikomeye gusumvya ibindi bikoko, itigera ihunga na kimwe,
isake ihagaze ku maguru yayo, isuguru y’impene, hamwe n’umwami agendera imbere y’ingabo ziwe.
Iyo wigize igipfu ukishira hejuru, canke ugategura gukora ikibi, pfuka n’urushi akanwa kawe.
Kuko nk’uko amata aterewe avamwo amavuta, izuru rikubiswe rikava umwuna, ni ko kuratsa umuntu bitera ibihari.”
Iyi ni imigani y’umwami Lemuweli, yavugishwa amajambo y’ubwenge yigishijwe na nyina.
Nyumviriza, mwana wanje! Ntega amatwi bura bwanje! Nyumviriza, mwana wanje, wewe nyishu y’amasengesho yanje.
Ntugahereze inkomezi zawe mu bagore, canke inguvu zawe ku bagwisha abami.
Si ivy’abami, ewe Lemuweli, si ivy’abami kunywa umuvinyu, n’abatware kunohokera inzoga,
kuko bonywa bakibagira ivyashinzwe, bakananirwa kugirira neza abacinyijwe.
Reka inzoga zibe iz’abahona, umuvinyu ube uw’abababaye!
Nibabe ari bo banywa, bibagire ubukene bwabo, ntibasubire kwibuka amagorwa yabo.
Uvugire abadashobora kwivugira, ugirire neza ba ntahonikora.
Uvuge kandi uce izibereye; uburanire aboro n’abakene.
Umugore w’imico myiza yova hehe? Asumba utubuye tw’agaciro.
Umugabo wiwe aramwizigira cane, kandi nta c’agaciro amuburana.
Azanira ivyiza umugabo, atari ibibi, imisi yose yo kubaho kwiwe.
Atoranya ubwoya bw’intama n’ipampa, akajisha impuzu n’amaboko yiwe anezerewe.
Ameze nk’ubwato bw’umudandaza, azana ivyokurya abikuye kure.
Avyuka bugihwibiriye; akaronderera indya umuryango, akaronderera n’incoreke ziwe.
Abona itongo akarishima, maze akarigura; maze mu biva mu vyo akora, ahatera uruzabibu.
Agira umwete mwinshi mu vyo akora, amaboko yiwe ayaha kurema.
Aramenya ko urudandazwa rwiwe rutera ruja imbere, kandi itara ryiwe ntirizima mw’ijoro.
Amaboko yiwe atunganya ubwoya bw’intama, intoke ziwe zikajisha impuzu
Apfumbaturura ibiganza agafasha aboro, akaramvurira amaboko gufasha abakene.
Mu gihe c’imbeho nyinshi, ntatinyira umuryango wiwe, kuko abambika izisusurutse.
Yijishira ivyo kwipfuka mw’ijoro, akambara izera derere n’izitukura.
Umugabo wiwe arubahwa kw’irembo ry’igisagara, iyo yicaranye n’abatware baho.
Ajisha imitamana yera derere akayigurisha, akaronkera imikenyezo abadandaza.
Yambaye inkomezi n’icubahiro ategekanya kazoza mu munezero.
Avugana ubwenge, kandi impanuro z’ubwizigirwa ziri mu kanwa kiwe.
Yitaho ibikorwa vy’umugabo wiwe, kandi ntarya ivyo atabiriye akuya.
Abana biwe bose baramushimagiza, umugabo wiwe akamushima avuga ati:
“Hari abagore benshi bakora ivyiza, ariko bose urabaruta.”
Kugira uburanga gusa birahenda, kandi ubwiza bwo ku rukoba nta co bumaze. Ariko umugore yubaha Uhoraho azoshimwa.
Arabereye guhabwa ibiva mu maboko yiwe, kandi ibikorwa yakoze bimushire hejuru kw’irembo ry’igisagara.
